name: Nandi Khumalo
bio:
Nandi Khumalo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Johannesburg, she initially pursued a career in electrical engineering, but a chance encounter with a local racing team sparked an enduring passion. She quickly transitioned from tinkering with circuits to mastering the intricacies of race car performance. Nandi's meticulous approach and unwavering dedication propelled her through the ranks, earning her a reputation for troubleshooting even the most complex technical challenges. 

Her time at Stake Sauber has been defined by a commitment to reliability and incremental improvement. Nandi believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their expertise. While she appreciates innovation, her primary focus remains on optimizing existing systems and ensuring consistent performance, a philosophy rooted in the belief that races are often won by those who can consistently avoid mistakes. Her calm demeanor under pressure is legendary within the team, making her an invaluable asset during high-stakes situations.

physical.hairStyle: short, tightly coiled afro, neatly trimmed
physical.description: Nandi is a stout woman with a warm smile and a perpetually focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten equations.
Prefers to communicate complex technical concepts through hand-drawn diagrams.
Insists on personally inspecting the fuel lines before every race.
